name: Kanso
tagline: Istanbul studio for brand, native app design, and development, behind the DATALAND museum app
description:
Kanso is an independent design and development studio in Istanbul, founded by Furkan Kılıç. A team of six covers brand, native app design, design systems, interaction design, and engineering. The name comes from the Japanese word for simplicity, and the studio states four principles: craft, clarity, care, and focus.

The site shows three case studies. Kanso designed and built the iOS and Android app of DATALAND, the museum of AI arts, from February to August 2026. The other cases are a sales service app for Derimod and a football scouting app for Pro Legacy. Testimonials come from Refik Anadol of DATALAND, Chiliz, and Derimod. The site publishes no prices.
pricing_detail: No published rates. Project requests go to hello@kanso.solutions, and the studio takes a limited number of projects each year.
agent_guidance:
Use it as a benchmark for a small product studio that designs and builds native apps end to end. Study the DATALAND case for a real-time companion app, and the studio page for team and principles copy.

The site is a Framer build with motion-heavy pages. Read the case studies in a browser, because the text alone misses the visuals.
why_it_matters: It shows how a six-person studio presents end-to-end native app work, from brand through engineering, with a museum-scale client case.
tier_reason: Strong client work and a clear service model, but only three published case studies and no prices.
notable_for: brand, design, and native development in one team
six-person team led by Furkan Kılıç
evidence: Checked https://kanso.solutions/, /work, /services, and /studio in curl and Chromium on 2026-10-12. The work page lists DATALAND and two more case studies. The services page lists brand, design, experience, and development. The studio page names six people, with Furkan Kılıç as founder. The footer shows Istanbul and a 2020 to 2026 copyright. The preview is a screenshot of the work page. The owner shared https://kanso.solutions/ on 2026-10-12.

name: Oversight
tagline: Webflow and Framer studio with public prices, custom sites from $1,000, and 180+ templates
description:
Oversight is a web design and development studio for startups, founders, and agencies, run as OversightStudio, LLC. Testimonials name Florent as the designer. It builds sites in Webflow and Framer and also offers branding. The about page claims 100+ Webflow templates, 500+ clients, and five years of work.

The studio publishes its prices: a one-page launch from $1,000, a multi-page Launchpad Sprint from $3,500, and a Growth Partner retainer at $1,500 a month. It sells 180+ templates, and Index lists its template membership, Oversight Supply, as its own record. The site shows templates and testimonials, but no client case studies.
pricing_detail: One-Page Launch from $1,000. Launchpad Sprint, a multi-page site, from $3,500. Growth Partner retainer at $1,500 a month for 15 hours of design and development. Single templates cost $99 on the studio site.
agent_guidance:
Use it as a benchmark for a template-led web studio that also sells custom builds, with public prices. Compare its three price tiers when you plan a studio pricing page.

For template work, use the Oversight Supply record, which covers the membership and the AI-ready prompts.
why_it_matters: It shows a studio model that funds custom work with a large template catalog and states its prices in public.
tier_reason: Public prices and a large template catalog show its craft, but the site has no client case studies.
notable_for: Growth Partner retainer at $1,500 a month
evidence: Checked https://www.madebyoversight.com/ and /about in curl and Chromium on 2026-10-12. The home page lists the three price tiers and the template catalog. The about page claims 100+ Webflow templates, 500+ clients, and five years of work. The Oversight Supply terms name OversightStudio, LLC. The preview is a home page screenshot. The owner asked on 2026-10-12 to add the studio.
